ruby.explanation: RFC 8610 §3.5.4 explicitly accepts optional-key:nonsense without a cut. Ruby commits to the matching key before trying the wildcard.

RFC 8610 §3.6 / Appendix D biguint explicitly uses tag 2. Ruby cddl.rb synthesizes a tag-2 bstr when validating any nonnegative decoded Integer, so it also accepts untagged integer 0. The RFC-derived tag expectation is retained.
Published RFC 8610 §3.8.6 implies .ne. Ruby implements annotation-only .default, as proposed by unverified erratum 9229.

RFC 8610 §2.2.3 defines representable value sets. Ruby cddl.rb validates #7.25/26/27 by re-encoding the float and comparing its shortest encoded width exactly; 1.5 therefore fails float32/float64 although representable in both.
